ratings.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with meaningful friction/limits; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional within assessed scope. Holistic subjective scores, not computed from wins, accuracy, mission time or score.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent, atmospheric and navigable touch mission with helpful feedback. Simultaneous movement and firing worked in short patrol samples. Cover misses, crowded short-screen UI and narrow sustained-control coverage limit confidence. Two wins alone do not justify the grade.
reasons.controls: Large separated controls, tap aiming and FIRE drag worked alongside MOVE; scene swipe and warning TURN responded. Short synthetic samples cannot establish thumb comfort, precision without tap assist, or continuous burst rearming.
reasons.gameplay: Observed recovery-to-coils-to-upload sequence gives clear progression and pressure from patrols/rear fire. Cover feedback and coil phases add decisions, but assisted route travel carried much of navigation; deeper movement/tactical variety and continuous enjoyment are unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Strong cyan/amber visual language, rain, industrial silhouettes and reflective lighting create a cohesive station atmosphere. Audio and actual hardware fluidity unassessed.
reasons.usability: Contextual route/approach labels, saved-name checks, paused map with close control, automatic reload and detailed end stats are helpful. Multi-paragraph handbook needs scrolling; screen space is tight.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo and upload/coil state are clear. Distant patrols, fine text and warning overlays compete with the scene at 844x390; screenshots permit more inspection than human continuous play.
